tr.zh: 市民中心·烹饪班介绍。A：每周二 18:30–20:30，鱼的日式料理，3,200日元。B：每周三 19:00–21:00，蔬菜咖喱，2,500日元。C：每周六 10:00–12:00，猪肉中华料理，2,800日元。D：每周五 17:00–19:00，蔬菜意面，2,000日元（均为每次的费用）。＊请在课程开始的前一个月20日之前，通过电话或在中心前台报名。＊费用请在上课当天到前台支付。＊请自带围裙和毛巾。
tr.en: Community Centre cooking classes. A: every Tuesday 18:30–20:30, Japanese fish dishes, ¥3,200. B: every Wednesday 19:00–21:00, vegetable curry, ¥2,500. C: every Saturday 10:00–12:00, Chinese pork dishes, ¥2,800. D: every Friday 17:00–19:00, vegetable pasta, ¥2,000 (prices per session). * Apply by the 20th of the month before the class starts, by phone or at the centre's front desk. * Pay at the front desk on the day of the class. * Bring an apron and a towel.

questions.q: リーさんが 入る ことが できる 教室は どれですか。

why.zh: 三个条件一起看：平日要在18点以后开始、不吃肉、每次3,000日元以内。B是星期三19:00开始、蔬菜咖喱、2,500日元，全部符合。
why.en: Check all three: on weekdays it must start after 6 p.m., no meat, ¥3,000 or less. B — Wednesday at 19:00, vegetable curry, ¥2,500 — meets them all.

wrong.zh: A的时间（18:30）和鱼都可以，但每次3,200日元，超过了3,000日元。
wrong.en: A's time (18:30) and fish are fine, but ¥3,200 is over her ¥3,000 limit.

wrong.zh: C在星期六，钱也够，但做的是猪肉（「ぶた肉」），李先生不吃肉。
wrong.en: C is on Saturday and affordable, but it's pork (「ぶた肉」), and Lee doesn't eat meat.

wrong.zh: D是蔬菜、2,000日元，但星期五17:00开始，那时李先生还在上班（到18点）。
wrong.en: D is vegetarian and ¥2,000, but it starts at 17:00 on Friday, while Lee works until 6.

questions.q: リーさんは どのように 申し込みますか。
options: 今月の 20日までに、電話か 受付で 申し込む。
来月の 20日までに、電話か 受付で 申し込む。
今月の 20日までに、受付で お金を はらって 申し込む。
教室が 始まる 日に、受付で 申し込む。
okj: 今月の20日までに、受付でお金を払って申し込む。

why.zh: 李先生想从「来月」开始上课；报名期限是「始まる 前の 月の 20日まで」，也就是这个月20日之前；方式是电话或前台。
why.en: Lee wants to start 「来月」; the deadline is 「始まる 前の 月の 20日まで」 — the 20th of this month — by phone or at the desk.

wrong.zh: 课程下个月开始，「前の 月」是这个月，下个月20日就太晚了。
wrong.en: The classes start next month, so 「前の 月」 is this month; next month's 20th is too late.

wrong.zh: 日期对，但钱是上课当天在前台付（「お金は 教室の 日に」），报名时不用付。
wrong.en: The date is right, but you pay on the class day (「お金は 教室の 日に」), not when applying.

wrong.zh: 上课当天是付钱的日子，报名必须在前一个月20日之前。
wrong.en: The class day is when you pay; applications close on the 20th of the month before.

tr.en: Bus timetable, University → Station. 8:00 hour — Mon–Fri :00 :15 :30 :45; Sat :10 :40; Sun/holidays :30. 9:00 hour — Mon–Fri :00 :15 :30 :45; Sat :10 :25 :40; Sun/holidays :30. 10:00 hour — Mon–Fri :00 :30; Sat :10 :40; Sun/holidays :30. 11:00 hour — Mon–Fri :00 :30; Sat :10 :40; Sun/holidays :30. * The ride from University to Station takes 30 minutes. * On Saturdays in November the 9:25 bus does not run because of road works. * The fare is 220 yen. * Please don't talk on the phone on the bus. * The timetable changes from December.

questions.q: 約束は 10時です。ゆいさんは 何時の バスに 乗りますか。

why.zh: 8日是星期六，看「土」那一列；车程30分钟，所以要在9:30之前发车。9:25那班11月的星期六停运，所以最晚是9:10（9:40到）。
why.en: The 8th is a Saturday, so use the 「土」 column; with a 30-minute ride the bus must leave by 9:30. The 9:25 doesn't run on Saturdays in November, so the latest is 9:10 (arriving 9:40).

wrong.zh: 8:40的车也来得及，但9:10还有一班更晚的车。
wrong.en: The 8:40 gets her there in time, but there's a later one at 9:10.

wrong.zh: 9:25本来能9:55到，但注意事项写着11月的星期六这班车停运。
wrong.en: The 9:25 would arrive at 9:55, but the note says it doesn't run on Saturdays in November.

wrong.zh: 9:30的车只有平日和周日·节假日才有，星期六没有。
wrong.en: There's a 9:30 only on weekdays and Sundays/holidays, not on Saturday.

questions.q: 約束の 時間が 11時に 変わったら、ゆいさんは 何時の バスに 乗りますか。

why.zh: 还是星期六：要在10:30之前发车。星期六10点有10分和40分两班，10:10发车10:40到，是最晚又不迟到的一班。
why.en: Still Saturday: the bus must leave by 10:30. Saturday's 10 o'clock buses are :10 and :40; the 10:10 arrives at 10:40 — the latest that's on time.

wrong.zh: 9:40的车来得及，但还有更晚的10:10。
wrong.en: The 9:40 is in time, but the 10:10 is later.

wrong.zh: 10:30的车只有平日和周日·节假日才有，星期六没有。
wrong.en: The 10:30 runs on weekdays and Sundays/holidays, not Saturdays.

wrong.zh: 10:40发车要11:10才到，会迟到。
wrong.en: The 10:40 arrives at 11:10 — she'd be late.

tr.zh: 绿市民游泳池·须知。大人（中学生以上）：周一至周五400日元，周六·周日·节假日500日元。儿童（小学生）：周一至周五200日元，周六·周日·节假日250日元。上小学以前的儿童：0日元。＊住在本市的大人出示能证明住址的卡，便宜100日元。＊周一至周五下午五点以后，大人一律250日元（出示卡也不再便宜）。＊小学生请和大人一起入场。＊每月第一个星期一休息。
tr.en: Midori City Pool — information. Adults (junior high and up): ¥400 Mon–Fri, ¥500 Sat/Sun/holidays. Children (primary school): ¥200 Mon–Fri, ¥250 Sat/Sun/holidays. Children under primary-school age: free. * Adults living in the city get ¥100 off by showing a card with their address. * From 5 p.m. Mon–Fri, all adults pay ¥250 (no card discount). * Primary-school children must come in with an adult. * Closed on the first Monday of each month.

questions.q: 日曜日、三人で いくら はらいますか。

why.zh: 星期日看「土・日・祝日」：大人500日元，两人都出示卡各便宜100日元，是400×2=800日元；小学二年生的女儿250日元（卡只对大人有效）。合计1,050日元。
why.en: Sunday uses the 「土・日・祝日」 column: adults ¥500 less ¥100 each with the card = ¥800; the daughter, a primary-school child, pays ¥250 (the card is adults only). Total ¥1,050.

wrong.zh: 800日元是平日价格（大人300×2+儿童200），星期日不适用。
wrong.en: ¥800 is the weekday price (2 × ¥300 + ¥200); it doesn't apply on Sunday.

wrong.zh: 1,150日元只给一个大人减了100日元；约翰的妻子也住在本市，也能便宜。
wrong.en: ¥1,150 takes ¥100 off only one adult; his wife lives in the city too.

wrong.zh: 1,250日元是没用卡的价格，但他们住在本市而且有卡。
wrong.en: ¥1,250 is the price without the card, but they live in the city and have it.

questions.q: 来週の 水曜日、ジョンさんは 一人で いくら はらいますか。

why.zh: 星期三晚上六点，符合「月〜金の 午後 五時からは、大人は だれでも 250円」，而且「カードで 安く なりません」，所以是250日元。
why.en: Wednesday at 6 p.m. falls under 「月〜金の 午後 五時からは、大人は だれでも 250円」, and 「カードで 安く なりません」 — so ¥250.

wrong.zh: 150日元是在250日元上又减了100日元，但五点以后用卡不能再便宜。
wrong.en: ¥150 takes another ¥100 off ¥250, but the card discount doesn't apply after 5 p.m.

wrong.zh: 300日元是平日白天用卡的价格（400−100），但他是晚上六点去，适用五点以后的价格。
wrong.en: ¥300 is the weekday daytime price with the card (¥400 − ¥100); at 6 p.m. the after-5 price applies.

wrong.zh: 400日元是平日大人的普通价格，没有考虑晚上的价格。
wrong.en: ¥400 is the normal weekday adult price, ignoring the evening rate.

tr.zh: 绿果汁工厂·参观介绍。周六 10:00–11:00，参观路线，无需预约，0日元。周六 14:00–15:30，参观＋制作路线，需要预约，每人300日元。周日 11:00–12:00，参观路线，无需预约，0日元。周日 15:00–16:30，参观＋制作路线，需要预约，每人300日元。＊“参观＋制作路线”在参观工厂后自己做果汁，小学生以上可以参加。＊请在参观三天前通过电话预约。＊费用请在参观当天到前台支付。＊小学生请和大人一起来。
tr.en: Midori Juice Factory — tours. Sat 10:00–11:00, viewing tour, no booking, free. Sat 14:00–15:30, view + make tour, booking required, ¥300 per person. Sun 11:00–12:00, viewing tour, no booking, free. Sun 15:00–16:30, view + make tour, booking required, ¥300 per person. * On the view + make tour you see the factory and then make juice yourself; open to primary-school children and up. * Book by phone at least three days before. * Pay at the front desk on the day. * Primary-school children must come with an adult.

questions.q: 山本さんと 息子は いつの 見学に 行きますか。

why.zh: 山本先生周六周日上午都有事，所以只能下午；周日下午儿子要练足球。剩下的只有星期六14点。
why.en: Mr Yamamoto is busy both weekend mornings, so it must be an afternoon; on Sunday afternoon his son has football. That leaves Saturday at 14:00.

wrong.zh: 星期六10点是上午，山本先生有事。
wrong.en: Saturday at 10 is in the morning, when Mr Yamamoto is busy.

wrong.zh: 星期日11点也是上午（「午前中」），山本先生有事。
wrong.en: Sunday at 11 is still the morning (「午前中」), when he's busy.

wrong.zh: 星期日15点是下午，但儿子要练足球。
wrong.en: Sunday at 15:00 is the afternoon, but his son has football practice.

questions.q: 山本さんは 見学の 前に 何を しなければ なりませんか。
options: 三日前までに、電話で 予約する。
三日前までに、二人分の 600円を はらう。
何も しないで、当日 受付へ 行く。
前の 日に、受付で 予約する。
okj: 三日前までに、二人分の600円を払う。

why.zh: 他们去的是星期六14点的“参观＋制作路线”，表上写着「予約　必要」；注意事项说「予約は 見学の 三日前までに、電話で」。
why.en: Their Saturday 14:00 slot is the view + make tour, marked 「予約　必要」; the note says to book 「見学の 三日前までに、電話で」.

wrong.zh: 两人确实是600日元，但钱是参观当天在前台付（「見学の 日に、受付で」），不用提前付。
wrong.en: It is ¥600 for two, but you pay at the desk on the day (「見学の 日に、受付で」), not in advance.

wrong.zh: 不用预约的是「見る コース」，他们参加的路线需要预约。
wrong.en: Only the 「見る コース」 needs no booking; their tour requires one.

wrong.zh: 预约要在三天前，而且是打电话，不是前一天去前台。
wrong.en: Booking must be by phone at least three days ahead, not at the desk the day before.
